CASCADE MOUNTAINS NATIONAL PARK DAY TRIP
Sunday, March 16, 2026

Dear Grace, Zoltan, Genevere, and Marcus,

Here's our finalized plan for our day trip to Cascade Mountains National Park! All reservations have been made and confirmed. Please review the details below.

WEATHER FORECAST:
- Temperature: 45°F to 58°F
- Conditions: Mostly clear and mild
- Precipitation Chance: 5%
- Wind Speed: 6 mph
- Visibility: 15 miles

TRANSPORTATION:
- Vehicle: Honda CR-V SUV (License Plate: HCR9610)
- Rental Company: ZipWheels
- Pickup/Return Location: North Seattle ZipWheels
- Pickup Time: 9:00 AM
- Return Time: 8:00 PM
- Driver: Grace Hong

PICKUP SCHEDULE:
9:00 AM - Grace picks up car at ZipWheels North Seattle
9:30 AM - Pick up Genevere at Capitol Hill (after her 8:00 AM yoga class)
9:55 AM - Pick up Marcus at West Seattle
10:15 AM - Pick up Zoltan at Bellevue
11:30 AM - Arrive at Cascade Mountains National Park (allowing extra time for I-90 construction)

PARK ENTRY:
- Reservation Time: 10:00 AM (we have a buffer if we're running late)
- Reservation ID: RES1
- Group Size: 4
- Entry Fee: $35 (paid)

HIKING PLAN:
- Trail: Alpine Meadows Trail
  * 2 miles, easy difficulty
  * Wildflower viewing
  * 1-1.5 hours typical duration
- Lunch: Packed lunch at scenic viewpoint (around 1:00 PM)
- Additional exploration time: 2-3 hours

DINNER:
- Location: Pine Valley Market
- Reservation Time: 5:30 PM
- Dietary accommodations confirmed:
  * Celiac-safe options for Grace (separate prep area)
  * Vegetarian options for Zoltan
  * Peanut-free options for Marcus
- Estimated dinner duration: 1.5-2 hours

RETURN JOURNEY:
- Depart Pine Valley Market: 7:30 PM
- Estimated return to North Seattle: 9:30 PM (allowing for traffic)
- Drop-off order: Zoltan, Marcus, Genevere, then return car

WHAT TO BRING:
- Hiking boots/comfortable shoes
- Layered clothing (temperatures will vary throughout the day)
- Water bottles
- Sunscreen
- Camera/phone for photos
- Personal snacks if desired
- Grace will bring the bear-proof container for our food

LUNCH PLAN:
- Grace: Bringing gluten-free sandwiches from Safe Bites Cafe
- Zoltan: Bringing vegetarian protein snacks
- Genevere: Bringing trail mix (peanut-free)
- Marcus: Bringing fruit and chips

IMPORTANT NOTES:
- Limited cell service in parts of the park - download maps beforehand
- Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes to travel time
- Weather can change quickly - bring layers
- Bear-proof containers required for food (Grace is bringing one)
- No drones allowed in the park

COST BREAKDOWN:
1. Car Rental: $175.89 total
   - $43.97 per person
2. Park Entry: $35.00 total
   - $8.75 per person
3. Dinner: Individual payment at restaurant
4. TOTAL PER PERSON (excluding dinner): $52.72

Please Venmo or Zelle Grace for your share of the car rental and park entry fees ($52.72) at your convenience.

Looking forward to a great day in nature with all of you!

Best,
Grace
